verdict.rationale: Better Auth ships as an official TypeScript package (`npm install better-auth`) with a server API (`auth.api` methods) and a typed client (`authClient.signUp.email`). It integrates with Next.js, Nuxt, SvelteKit, Hono and 20+ more frameworks, and community users praise its type-safe DX and consistent use across frameworks. One user reports the client library is JS-only, with virtually no documentation on writing your own client for iOS. missing for 10: official SDKs beyond JavaScript/TypeScript (e.g., native mobile), documentation for building custom clients, a published OpenAPI spec for generating SDKs (the probe found none).
